app.name: Orbit
nav.readonlyNote: Read-only observability. Orbit never runs or controls anything.
dataset.demoBanner: Every value on this screen is synthetic and does not reflect your real usage. You can switch back to real data in Settings.
watcher.watching.help: File changes are being watched. This does not mean any process is running.
watcher.polling.help: Checking at regular intervals instead of using file events.
watcher.off.help: Automatic watching is off; scan manually for new data.
watcher.error.help: The watcher could not start; manual scanning still works.
filter.invalid: The start date cannot be after the end date.
quality.label: Data quality
quality.observed.help: Value seen directly in the log files.
quality.estimated.help: Based on a hypothetical rule; not an actual charge.
quality.unknown.help: This value could not be determined reliably.
reason.observedUsage: Read from usage counters in the logs.
reason.estimatedValue: API price equivalent; not a subscription charge.
money.footnote: Amounts are not a Pro/Max bill; they are the Estimated API-equivalent value (USD) from applying hypothetical API rates to observed tokens. Models without a known rate are excluded from totals.
coverage.unpriced.one: {count} request is unpriced and excluded from the estimated value.
coverage.unpriced.other: {count} requests are unpriced and excluded from the estimated value.
coverage.unlinked.one: {count} agent could not be linked to a session.
coverage.unlinked.other: {count} agents could not be linked to a session.
coverage.malformed.one: {count} line could not be read and was skipped.
coverage.malformed.other: {count} lines could not be read and were skipped.
coverage.archivedOnly.one: {count} request exists only in the Orbit archive; its source file is gone.
coverage.archivedOnly.other: {count} requests exist only in the Orbit archive; their source files are gone.
coverage.fallback.one: {count} request was estimated with a fallback pricing rule.
coverage.fallback.other: {count} requests were estimated with a fallback pricing rule.
coverage.allGood: No coverage gaps are visible in this range. Local history is still never assumed to be complete.
coverage.note: Local log files may be incomplete; Orbit only counts what it finds.
kpi.requests.help: Streaming duplicates removed; each API response is counted once.
hero.title: One hub. Every local session.
hero.sentence: Between {from} and {to}, Orbit observed {requests} across {sessions} in {projects}.
hero.empty: No usage was observed in the selected range.
overview.empty.title: No usage found in this range
overview.empty.body: Widen the date range, clear the filters, or rescan from Settings.
export.note: Summary per day × project × model with the current filters.
orbit.alt: Orbit illustration: {projects} projects, {sessions} sessions and {agents} subagents shown as nodes.
chart.valueNote: Values are Estimated API-equivalent value (USD), not a bill.
lanes.note: Hours follow the selected timezone; each cell shows the observed invocations in that hour.
insight.none: Not enough data for highlights yet.
insight.most_active_project: The most active project is {project}, with {sharePct} of processed tokens.
insight.cache_read_share: {sharePct} of processed tokens were read from cache.
insight.delegation_share: {sharePct} of requests came from subagents ({agentRequests} requests).
insight.busiest_day: The busiest day was {date} with {requests} requests.
insight.unpriced_warning: {requests} requests are unpriced and excluded from the estimated value.
insight.model_leader: The most used model is {model} with a {sharePct} share.
table.scrollHint: Scroll the table horizontally to see all columns.
error.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND.title: Source folder not found
error.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND.body: The Claude Code history folder does not exist at this path. Check that it exists (default ~/.claude/projects) or enter another absolute path.
error.PERMISSION_DENIED.title: No permission to read the folder
error.PERMISSION_DENIED.body: Orbit could not read the folder. Check OS permissions (for example Full Disk Access on macOS) and folder rights. Orbit only reads and never changes anything.
error.SCAN_IN_PROGRESS.title: A scan is already running
error.SCAN_IN_PROGRESS.body: Results update automatically when the current scan finishes.
error.PARTIAL_TRANSCRIPT.title: Log only partly readable
error.PARTIAL_TRANSCRIPT.body: Some log files are incomplete or damaged; only the readable part was counted.
error.RATE_NOT_FOUND.title: Rate not found
error.RATE_NOT_FOUND.body: Some models have no entry in the rate schedule; those requests are excluded from the estimated value.
error.UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_SCHEMA.title: Unsupported log format
error.UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_SCHEMA.body: The log file format was not recognised. Orbit may need an update.
error.INVALID_FILTER.title: Invalid filter
error.INVALID_FILTER.body: Change the date range or filters and try again.
error.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.title: Export too large
error.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.body: Narrow the date range and try again.
error.APP_ARCHIVE_NOT_INITIALIZED.title: Orbit archive not ready
error.APP_ARCHIVE_NOT_INITIALIZED.body: Run a scan first or choose the demo data.
error.NO_COVERAGE.title: No coverage
error.NO_COVERAGE.body: No observed records exist in the selected range.
error.CROSS_ORIGIN_DENIED.title: Request denied
error.CROSS_ORIGIN_DENIED.body: Orbit can only be used from its own local address. Open the page via 127.0.0.1.
error.CSRF_REQUIRED.title: Session could not be verified
error.CSRF_REQUIRED.body: Reload the page and try again.
error.CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Consent required first
error.CONSENT_REQUIRED.body: You must consent before the local history is scanned.
error.NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
error.NOT_FOUND.body: The requested record is not in this dataset. Demo and real data are kept separate.
error.RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many attempts
error.RATE_LIMITED.body: Wait a moment and try again.
error.INTERNAL.title: An unexpected error occurred
error.INTERNAL.body: The local server could not complete the request. Try again; if it persists, restart the server.
error.NETWORK.title: Cannot reach the local server
error.NETWORK.body: Make sure the Orbit server is running (127.0.0.1:4317) and try again.
onboard.title: Your Claude Code work, in one orbit.
onboard.lead: Orbit reads the Claude Code history on this computer and summarises usage for your projects, sessions and agents. No account, API key or network connection needed.
onboard.customPathHelp: Leave empty to use the default folder. The path is validated on this computer only and never shown in the interface.
onboard.readonly: Read-only: Orbit never modifies, deletes or executes your source files.
onboard.coverage: Local history may be incomplete; Orbit only counts the records it finds.
onboard.estimate: Pro/Max usage is not an actual bill. Amounts shown are Estimated API-equivalent value (USD).
onboard.noNetwork: No data leaves this computer; there is no telemetry or remote service.
onboard.noConsentNoScan: No file is scanned until you press the button below.
onboard.archiveHelp: When on, numeric usage summaries stay in Orbit's own database even after the source file is deleted. No text content is stored. Off by default; changeable in Settings.
onboard.demoHelp: The demo does not use your real data; it shows the interface with made-up sample sessions.
projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Projects with the same name stay separate, told apart by a short code. Aliases are stored only in Orbit; your repositories are never touched.
projects.empty.title: No projects in this range
projects.empty.body: Widen the date range or rescan from Settings.
project.collision: Another project has the same name; the short code tells them apart.
project.archivedHelp: Source files can no longer be found; values come from the Orbit archive.
project.unlinkedWarning.one: {count} agent could not be linked to a session; the agent split for this project may be incomplete.
project.unlinkedWarning.other: {count} agents could not be linked to a session; the agent split for this project may be incomplete.
cache.note: {share} of processed tokens are cache reads; total cache tokens {total}.
alias.title: Alias (Orbit only)
alias.help: Up to 60 characters. Your repositories and log files are not changed.
alias.badChars: The alias cannot contain control characters or < >.
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.lead: Each row is one Claude Code session. Task titles and prompt text are never shown.
sessions.empty.title: No sessions in this range
sessions.empty.body: Widen the date range or clear the filters.
sessions.requestNote: The request column is the number of unique API requests, not a message count.
session.truncated: Only the first 1000 requests are shown.
session.noAgents: No subagents were observed in this session.
agents.title: Agents
agents.lead: Subagents seen in the logs and how they link to sessions. Statuses rely only on log timestamps; they do not show that a process is running.
agents.statusNote: “Observed recently” means the last log event is recent; it does not verify the agent is running now.
agents.empty.title: No agents observed in this range
agents.empty.body: Sessions that used subagents appear here. Try widening the date range.
agent.toolNotMatched: Tool call id did not match.
agent.observedNote: A new log event was observed recently. This does not prove a process is running.
agent.noParent: This agent could not be linked to a session.
linkReason.generic: The link was inferred from hints in the logs. Code:
linkReason.meta_tool_use_id_match: The tool call id in the parent log matched the agent's metadata exactly.
linkReason.sidechain_parent_match: The agent log points directly at an event in the parent session.
linkReason.single_candidate: Only one plausible parent session fits by time and project; the link is inferred.
linkReason.time_window_match: The agent's timing falls within a parent session's invocation window; the link is inferred.
linkReason.no_parent_found: No parent session was found for this agent.
graph.label: Orbit graph showing sessions and their agents
graph.truncated: The graph shows a limited number of nodes; use the list for all agents.
graph.note: Node size is proportional to processed tokens. Everything in the graph is also in the list below.
settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: All settings are stored only on this computer.
settings.timezoneHelp: Days and hours are grouped using the {tz} timezone.
settings.moneyNote: Currency is always USD and is never converted.
settings.dataset.realHelp: Data read from your local Claude Code history.
settings.dataset.needConsent: To use real data, first consent to scanning your local history.
settings.dataset.demoHelp: Made-up sample sessions; not your real usage.
settings.pathHelp: The folder is validated; only its ~-shortened label is shown.
settings.rates.none: No overrides defined; the bundled rate schedule is used.
settings.rates.row: USD per million tokens: input {input} · output {output} · cache read {cacheRead}
settings.rates.note: Overrides are stored on this computer only; the official rate schedule is not modified.
settings.delete.body: Deletes Orbit's own database and archive. Your Claude Code log files are not touched.
settings.delete.title: Delete Orbit data?
settings.delete.sourceSafe: This cannot be undone; your source files are not affected.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
graph.moreSessions: +{count} more sessions (top {max} by tokens shown) — use the list.
graph.moreAgents: {count} more agents of the shown sessions are not drawn.
graph.keys: Keyboard: Tab into the graph, arrow keys move between nodes, Enter opens details.
rates.title: Rate overrides
rates.intro: Local overrides are stored only on this computer and take precedence over the official rates. Saving re-prices every estimated value.
rates.row: USD per 1M tokens: input {input} · output {output} · cache read {cacheRead} · {from} → {to}
rates.err.decimal: Enter a non-negative decimal (up to 6 integer and 6 fractional digits).
rates.err.range: The end must be after the start.
rates.err.overlap: Local intervals of the same model must not overlap.
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.lead: Observed activity intervals per project or agent.
timeline.legend: Intervals are spans inferred from log timestamps; they are not CPU time or verified run time. Each interval groups nearby requests of a single session.
timeline.truncated: Too many intervals; the view was limited. Narrow the range or apply a filter.
timeline.empty.title: No activity in this range
timeline.empty.body: Try widening the date range or removing filters.
timeline.chartLabel: Timeline: {lanes} lanes, {count} intervals. Details are in the table below.
timeline.hint: Hover an interval or pick one from the table; details appear here.
costs.title: Costs
costs.lead: Observed token usage priced with hypothetical API rates. This is not a bill.
costs.coverageWarning: Coverage is below 100% ({pct}): {count} requests are unpriced and excluded from the total. The real estimated value may be higher.
costs.empty.title: No usage in this range
costs.empty.body: Widen the date range or remove filters.
costs.unsplitNote: Fallback rate: the 5 min cache-write rate is applied (no 5 min / 1 h split in the log).
costs.categoryNote: Only priced requests are included. Cache writes are priced separately for 5 min and 1 h; the aggregate and its split are never counted twice.
costs.notModeledHelp: The items below are not modeled; the real API value may therefore differ.
costs.rateCardNote: Rate columns show USD per 1 million tokens. Local overrides are visually distinct.
costs.unpricedBody: The schedule has no rate for these models. Their tokens are visible but excluded from the estimated value and never counted as USD 0. You can define a local rate.
costs.definePrice.missingModel: The log has no model ID; a price cannot be defined.
reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Pick a range, projects and models, review the privacy preview, then download CSV/JSON or start Story Mode.
reports.metaNote: The JSON file also carries methodology metadata: rate schedule version, excluded unknown models, coverage window and the disclaimer.
reports.aggregation: Rows are aggregated per day × project × model; individual requests are never exported.
reports.downloadNote: Files are generated by the local server with the selected range, project and model filters; nothing leaves your computer.
story.title: Story Mode
story.empty: No usage was observed in this range; there is nothing to show on this slide.
story.noClaim: The data does not support a takeaway for this slide.
story.keys: Keyboard: ← → Space PageUp PageDown to move, Home/End for first/last slide, Esc to exit.
story.s1.title: What happened in this period?
story.s1.range: Local Claude Code activity from {from} to {to}.
story.s1.scope: Only usage observed in logs on this computer; logs may be incomplete.
story.s1.takeaway: In this range: {requests}, {sessions} and {projects} were observed.
story.s2.title: Activity
story.s3.title: Estimated value
story.s3.caveat: This figure is not a subscription bill; it only covers requests with a known price.
story.s3.takeaway: {pct} of requests were priced; {count} unpriced requests are excluded from the total.
story.s4.title: Project distribution
story.s5.title: Model mix
story.s6.title: Delegation to subagents
story.s6.takeaway: {pct} of requests came from subagents ({agent} of {total}).
story.s6.none: No subagent requests were observed in this range.
story.s7.title: Cache efficiency
story.s7.takeaway: Cache reads make up {pct} of processed tokens.
story.s8.title: Coverage and methodology
story.s8.takeaway: {pct} of requests were priced; {count} unpriced requests were excluded.
story.s8.takeawayFull: All requests were priced (coverage {pct}); it is still an estimate.
